outcome: death from any cause through day 28

citations.text: The primary objective of the trial was to assess the efficacy of nirmatrelvir plus ritonavir as compared with placebo by comparing the percentage of patients with Covid-19–related hospitalization or death from any cause through day 28 in the two groups.

All the data were available to all the authors, who vouch for the accuracy and completeness of the data as well as the adherence of the trial to the protocol, which is available at NEJM.org and includes the statistical analysis plan.

5.1.reasoning: The paper cites a protocol with a statistical analysis plan and a registration number but gives no date for either, and the pre-specified primary analysis it describes is the composite of Covid-19–related hospitalization or death, not death from any cause through day 28, which is only reported as raw counts; there is therefore no dated plan fixing an analysis for this outcome to compare against.

citations.text: Nine deaths were reported in the placebo group and none in the nirmatrelvir group.
All 13 deaths occurred in the placebo group.
Through day 34, no serious adverse events resulted in death among recipients of nirmatrelvir plus ritonavir; there were 13 deaths among placebo recipients, and all the deaths were Covid-19–related

5.2.reasoning: Death from any cause through day 28 is a single, unambiguous measurement that can be ascertained in only one way, and the paper reports the deaths consistently across the modified intention-to-treat population (0 vs 9 through day 28) and the safety population (0 vs 13 through day 34), so there were no alternative versions of this outcome to choose among.

citations.text: The primary analysis compared proportions of patients in the two groups who were hospitalized for Covid-19 or died from any cause through day 28, using the Kaplan–Meier method to account for all patients, including those prematurely withdrawn from the trial or lost to follow-up.
See the Supplementary Appendix for additional details regarding the statistical analyses, including handling of missing data.

5.3.reasoning: The paper gives no dated registration, protocol or analysis plan that fixes how death from any cause through day 28 was to be analysed (crude proportions versus Kaplan–Meier estimates, and which population), so there is no plan to hold the reported counts against even though more than one analysis approach was available.
